title: The Removed Stop | The next lead

police.speaker: Detective Morris
police.text: We will verify the amended minibus stop list and keep its source intact. A lead is not a rescue; we cannot assume Victor stayed there.

signal.speaker: David
signal.text: I will check the technical trail behind the amended minibus stop list. Amara, tell me what the records cannot explain.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: I am following the amended minibus stop list without police backup. Amara has my location; I am not going to turn this into a contest with Victor.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: A public stop was replaced with a loading bay behind the hall.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: The loading bay is empty. A steward remembers a missing equipment crate.

choices.label: Coordinate the next lead with the police
choices.impact: Bring Morris into the next investigation and preserve the evidence behind the amended minibus stop list.
choices.response: Morris takes the lead into the formal investigation. David checks the record while Amara explains its personal significance.
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Decode the next connection with Amara
choices.impact: David checks the technical trail from the amended minibus stop list; Amara tests it against her own history.
choices.response: David saves the original record and checks its connections. Amara refuses to let Victor's version replace what she remembers.
choices.speaker: David

choices.label: Follow the next trail without police backup
choices.impact: David follows the physical lead from the amended minibus stop list, keeping Amara informed.
choices.response: David sends Amara his location before moving. Finding Ethan matters more than claiming the search as his own achievement.
choices.speaker: David

metadata.evidence_summary: A public stop was replaced with a loading bay behind the hall. The loading bay is empty. A steward remembers a missing equipment crate.
